name: My zdes navsegda
source:
"Quite a few shifts have passed since Semyon, Slavya, Ulyana, and Zhenya left the camp. They are among the few who managed to get a round-trip ticket from Sovyonok. Before this, I think, nobody had ever succeeded.

But I, as one of those who remained trapped here in the system, need to get out by any means necessary and save those left behind... Or, more precisely, just Lena. That is the only reason why I am still here. I will bring Lena back to the real world, no matter what it takes."

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=942722225]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“自从谢苗、斯拉维亚、乌里扬娜和热尼亚离开营地以来，已经过去了相当多的轮班时间。他们是少数能够从索维诺克获得往返机票的人之一。我认为，在此之前，没有人成功过。

但我，作为仍然被困在系统中的人之一，需要以任何必要的方式出去并拯救那些留下来的人……或者，更准确地说，只是莉娜。这是我还在这里的唯一原因。无论付出什么代价，我都会把莉娜带回现实世界。”

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=942722225]Steam[/url]]
